description: Source code for the 'Packing Slip' document in ERPNext, including validation, item management, and database interactions.

classes.name: PackingSlip
classes.description: Represents a packing slip document with validation and item management methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before saving the packing slip, including delivery note status, item mandatory fields, case numbers, and quantities.

methods.name: validate_delivery_note
methods.description: Ensures the associated delivery note is not submitted.

methods.name: validate_items_mandatory
methods.description: Checks that there are items to pack.

methods.name: validate_case_nos
methods.description: Validates case number overlaps and assigns recommended case numbers.

methods.name: validate_qty
methods.description: Checks that packed quantities do not exceed delivery note quantities.

methods.name: get_details_for_packing
methods.description: Retrieves delivery note items, current packing quantities, and number of cases.

methods.name: recommend_new_qty
methods.description: Calculates and raises exception for new quantity recommendations.

methods.name: update_item_details
methods.description: Fills in missing item weight details.

methods.name: get_recommended_case_no
methods.description: Provides the next available case number for a new packing slip.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items to be packed based on delivery note details.
